column1: # Perl fact counters: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex), counted over the whole file. The
# [ignore] line runs first and reads the file as perl does, leftmost region first: it blanks POD,
# comment lines, keeping the line breaks, so a sub named in the documentation or in a usage text does
# not count, and a heredoc marker inside a comment or POD inside a heredoc opens nothing. Counts are
# regex heuristics: a sub generated with eval or a glob assignment is not seen, and of two heredocs
# started on one line (print <<A, <<B;) only the first body is blanked. "die, croak and confess"
# counts the calls that start a statement or follow or / and / || / && / //, so the German article in
# a message does not count. PerlFactPatternsTest pins every case.
[ignore] POD, __END__, heredoc bodies and comment lines
